deg <- graph_test(cds, neighbor_graph="principal_graph")
deg1 <- deg %>% filter (status == "OK", q_value <= 0.05, abs(deg$morans_I) >= 0.2)
# Plot the Venn Diagram
# Define colors similar to your image
venn_colors <- c("#AF4C8F", "#469A9F", "#E18141")

# Create the Venn diagram
venn.plot <- draw.triple.venn(
  area1 = 259,  # M
  area2 = 426,  # T
  area3 = 454,  # E
  n12 = 133,    # MT
  n23 = 144,    # TE
  n13 = 74,     # ME
  n123 = 47,    # MTE
  category = c("M", "T", "E"),
  fill = venn_colors,
  alpha = 0.5,  # Transparency to achieve a soft blend
  lty = "solid",
  lwd = 2,
  cex = 2,
  cat.cex = 2,
  cat.col = venn_colors
)
